clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, travelers honor Bronzebeard the Elder in Ironforge. His greeting offers wisdom and a token of esteem. The people of Khaz Modan revere their forebears and their long-lived heritage.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits and venerable elders appear across Azeroth to share wisdom with travelers who honor the past. In Ironforge, Elder Bronzebeard embodies the Bronzebeard clan’s stalwart resilience. When travelers come to pay their respects, he is quietly pleased that the people still honor the lineage of the old races.

No great trial or perilous journey is needed. Travelers pause, acknowledge Elder Bronzebeard, and offer a greeting. He returns their good wishes and gives them a Coin of Ancestry, a festival token that recalls the living bond between the present and the generations who forged Khaz Modan from stone and fire.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, friend, and offer you this token...
